claim_text: Vegetarian diets provide predominantly non-heme iron, which is less bioavailable on average than heme iron; this affects dietary reference assumptions but does not mean every vegetarian or vegan person requires an iron supplement.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, evidence-based nutrient assessment and avoid unsupported or unnecessary supplementation.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Iron Health Professional Fact Sheet discusses non-heme iron bioavailability and vegetarian reference intake considerations.
limitations: Dietary pattern alone does not diagnose deficiency or determine a supplement dose.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
